connector.name: MCP Gera Persona
connector.registryDescription: GeraPersona MCP - voice/personality skin marketplace for robots and AI agents (70/30 rev-share).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-gera-persona. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the geraservicesuk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GERA_PERSONA_API_BASE
env.description: Base URL for the GeraPersona API. Defaults to https://persona.gera.services

env.name: GERA_PERSONA_API_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for write tools (install_persona, get_creator_revenue). Not required for read-only search + get_persona + list_categories.
